quests.title: Your Four-Week Outcome
quests.blurb: I don't need you to have a job. I need a job to have had you — four weeks, on a form. Suite 3, above the tile showroom, Reserve Road. Buzz twice. The first buzzer does nothing and I've claimed for that too.

steps.label: sit the ninety-minute course he bills at four hundred
attend the interview, one stop up the line
photograph the shopfront so the interview happened
clear $40 so the form shows commencement earnings
sign the claim, dated the Monday before last

quests.title: Photographic Evidence of the Hedge
quests.blurb: There is a hedge on Ocean Avenue that has grown four metres since the orders. I am not permitted within a hundred metres of it. Nobody knows who you are, which makes you the most useful person in the eastern suburbs.

steps.label: buy a flat white on the way through Double Bay and carry it like it is yours
walk up Ocean Avenue — there is no station, that is the whole point of the suburb — and photograph the hedge from the public footpath
someone will come out and ask what you are doing. Someone always comes out
back to Edgecliff and show him the phone

quests.title: The Harbour Bridge Rail Experience
quests.blurb: Twelve dollars. Three minutes. Unrivalled harbour views. Five more for the harbour side, and don't you dare tell them which side that is. The hard part is the photograph. I'll explain the photograph.

steps.label: round up the punters from under the face
take the fares and the harbour-side upgrade
run the crossing: one stop, facing the water
shoot the bridge from the Quay, where it fits
handle the customer who counted the stops

quests.title: Evidence of Vibrancy
quests.blurb: Category B placemaking grant. To get the money that fixes the piazza I first have to prove the piazza is already in use. Footfall, retail expenditure, a photo, one objection. You are the footfall.

steps.label: photograph the Italian Forum piazza in use. You are the use.
record one (1) instance of retail expenditure on the Norton Street dining precinct
arrive by light rail. Category B is transit-oriented, so the arrival has to be one you can evidence.
record Kevin's objection. In full, and once.

quests.title: One Short for the Triples
quests.blurb: Kev's done his hamstring at touch footy, so we're two and the constitution says three. Club's woods are in Wazza's ute at Rooty Hill. Get them, get the train back, be on the green before four.

steps.label: find Wazza's ute at Rooty Hill; the club's woods are behind the seat
ask Wazza for the bowls, then ask Wazza's apprentice, who has the keys
one stop on the train; nobody drives home from a triples
move $25 of meat raffle tickets before the draw
photograph the green for the council grant: evidence of community usage
